verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for a SaaS payroll provider that holds sensitive company data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about whether Gusto uses customer data to train AI models or offers an opt-out. The MCP server's per-category data scoping and the CLI's telemetry opt-out control data access and usage analytics, not model training, so they do not deliver this story.
